name: calculate_irr
description: Compute the IRR for a commercial real estate deal from its purchase price, year-1 NOI, NOI growth rate, hold period, and exit cap rate. Returns the IRR %, total return %, year-1 cash flow, exit value, and the full cash-flow series. Deterministic bisection solver.

purchasePrice.description: Acquisition price in USD. Must be greater than 0.

netOperatingIncome.description: Year-1 net operating income (NOI) in USD.

noiGrowthRate.description: Annual NOI growth as a percent, e.g. 3 for 3%.

holdPeriod.description: Hold period in whole years. Must be at least 1.

exitCapRate.description: Exit capitalization rate as a percent, e.g. 6.5 for 6.5%. Must be greater than 0.

name: run_sensitivity
description: Run a one-variable-at-a-time tornado sensitivity for a CRE deal: sweep each input around the base case and report how much the IRR moves. Rate inputs sweep in basis points; dollar/period inputs sweep ±10/±20%. Variables are returned sorted by IRR spread (widest first).

purchasePrice.description: Acquisition price in USD. Must be greater than 0.

netOperatingIncome.description: Year-1 net operating income (NOI) in USD.

noiGrowthRate.description: Annual NOI growth as a percent, e.g. 3 for 3%.

holdPeriod.description: Hold period in whole years. Must be at least 1.

exitCapRate.description: Exit capitalization rate as a percent, e.g. 6.5 for 6.5%. Must be greater than 0.
